", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u019-r0018", "tag": "p", "text": "“It’s just the kind of faces one would expect of lost souls,” Leoncia answered.", "sha256": "384b9543b2b99a604e31750a516f9c06421279cc13a19e348020e1bc1a2c8d0c", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[1554]", "source_html": "

“It’s just the kind of faces one would expect of lost souls,” Leoncia answered.

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u019-r0019", "tag": "p", "text": "“And if we never get out of here, I suppose we’ll get to looking a whole lot sadder than they do,” he came back. “Anyway, I hope they’re leading us to breakfast. Those berries were better than nothing, but that is not saying much.”", "sha256": "8e7b27cd14d42647f14f8fe3527531c3a4ed313770bb1fec1c78504f055d97f2", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[1555]", "source_html": "

“And if we never get out of here, I suppose we’ll get to looking a whole lot sadder than they do,” he came back. “Anyway, I hope they’re leading us to breakfast. Those berries were better than nothing, but that is not saying much.”

An hour or more afterward, still obediently following their 169guides, they emerged upon the clearings, the dwelling places, and the Long House of the tribe.

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u019-r0021", "tag": "p", "text": "“These are descendants of Da Vasco’s party and the Caribs,” Torres affirmed, as he glanced over the assembled faces. “That is incontrovertible on the face of it.”", "sha256": "4334da8d8b3bd463660b893f354a4afb1c9bbc4d7b8ff52363f70eeba7a41453", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[1557]", "source_html": "

“These are descendants of Da Vasco’s party and the Caribs,” Torres affirmed, as he glanced over the assembled faces. “That is incontrovertible on the face of it.”

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u019-r0022", "tag": "p", "text": "“And they’ve relapsed from the Christian religion of Da Vasco to old heathen worship,” added Francis. “Look at that altar——there. It’s a stone altar, and, from the smell of it, that is no breakfast, but a sacrifice that is cooking, in spite of the fact that it smells like mutton.”", "sha256": "a68eab90b13820efdcb84116949daa0d7cfaea8e48ecf4364ad7f8fa1d34110c", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[1558]", "source_html": "

Behind and above the altar, was a great metal image of the sun.

“Merciful God!—look at that!” Leoncia gasped, indicating with her eyes a crude stone bust that stood to one side of the altar and slightly lower. “It is the face of Torres. It is the face of the mummy in the Maya cave.”
